question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:** NEBULOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vague**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"nebulous"** refers to something that is unclear, vague, or ill-defined. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **Her plans for the future remain nebulous and lack a clear direction.
 

 
• **"Vague"** means not clearly expressed, defined, or understood; it is similar in meaning to "nebulous." (अनिश्चित)

 
 
• **Example: **He gave a vague answer when asked about his goals.
 

 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'nebulous'** is **'vague'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Vague**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Precise **(सटीक): Clearly defined or accurate; not ambiguous or vague.

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were precise and easy to follow.
 

 
• **Obvious **(स्पष्ट): Easily understood or clear; not difficult to see or understand.

 
 
• **Example: ** It was obvious from his expression that he was upset.
 

 
• **Clear** (साफ): Easily perceived or understood; free from ambiguity or doubt.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave a clear explanation of the topic.

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e
